title: Correct final answer (1)
description: Essential: The student's answer for part (1) must be exactly 2.5 m/s.

title: Correct final answer (2)
description: Essential: The student's answer for part (2) must be v0 ≥ 1.5√6 m/s (or equivalent numerical form).

title: Projectile kinematics for (1)
description: Important: The solution for part (1) correctly applies the vertical displacement equation H - R = (1/2)gt² to find the time of flight.

title: Horizontal motion for (1)
description: Important: The solution for part (1) correctly relates the horizontal displacement R to the initial velocity and time via R = v0 t.

title: Tangency condition for (2)
description: Important: The solution for part (2) establishes the condition that the projectile's trajectory is tangent to the hemisphere's surface.

title: Geometry of tangency
description: Important: The solution correctly relates the projectile's coordinates (x, y) at the tangency point to the circle's geometry (x = R + R cosθ, y = R sinθ).

title: Velocity direction at tangency
description: Important: The solution correctly uses the projectile's velocity components to state tanθ = v0 / (gt) at the point of tangency.

title: Algebraic/trigonometric solution
description: Optional: The solution successfully solves the system of equations from the geometry and kinematics to find the critical velocity.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: All working and final answers include correct SI units (m, s, m/s).

title: Misinterpreting vertical drop
description: Pitfall: Using H = 1.8 m instead of (H - R) = 0.8 m for the vertical displacement in part (1).

title: Incorrect range condition
description: Pitfall: Stating the range for part (2) as v0 ≤ (some value) instead of v0 ≥ (some value).
